about: Intro track IN-4, the way back (drafts for the owner, 2026-10-29): every line of the lab scene (cutscenes/return.json) and of the Bureau’s pickup (story.json pickup-lost, pickup-won), its speaker (a look id), expression and stamp, and their own commands, in order, played on a stub with Pat. return-script.test.mjs compares them; a change to the words changes this file on purpose.

return.text: You came out of the sky. Again. Once is an accident. Twice is a brand.
I took the next train home, by the way. First class. They gave me a blanket for the shock. I wasn’t in shock. I kept the blanket.
You’re outside the lab, in Copperleaf. Nothing’s broken. I checked. Twice.
Before anything else: who are you? Still nothing? Fine. We’ll build you from scratch. Like a legend.
Pat. Strong name. Second-strongest on this porch.
Now, what you brought back. Empty your pockets. I’ll count.
That square of light in front of the train? You came down through one just now. It’s the Bureau’s.
The Bureau? Paperwork people. Don’t sign anything. I signed one thing once. I still get letters.
Here’s the plan. Skyline Station, just up the hill. Its trains go out past the island, to wild places nobody’s mapped.
Every trip is a new region. New Billies, new leaders. You never get the same one twice.
What you catch can come home with you. What you learn turns into Research, for the lab. That stays, whatever happens out there.
And every trip, you come back stronger. Like a training montage. I love a montage.
Rest first. The station isn’t going anywhere. Neither are we.

pickup-lost.text: Don’t get up. You’re exactly where the form says you’d be.
One person, unregistered. Fell off a train. No ticket. Also lost a fight.
Several fights. It’s all on the form. We have a form for that.
Sender, unclear. Address, unclear. So it goes back to the default address.

pickup-won.text: Hold still. You beat our retrieval scout. That scout was on loan.
One person, unregistered. One scout, dented. Both found at the scene.
Good work, technically. We don’t do good work here. We do paperwork.
